facts.fact: The Universite numerique Cheikh Hamidou Kane says its Max Planck Research Partner Group, focused on regulation of the digital economy, held a launch conference-workshop in March 2022 on data governance in emerging economies.

The Universite numerique Cheikh Hamidou Kane says its Max Planck Research Partner Group published a report, available on SSRN, on Senegal's regulatory framework for data access and sharing in agriculture and financial services.
